handoff.summary: Cycle R-20260810T170218+0900-27e4ce completed T-024 (priority/deadline model layer) with all gates green (targeted GroupPriorityDeadlineTests 13/13, just swift-test, zig build, just test - all exit 0). Remaining must: T-025/T-026 (overlay UI + display), T-027 (sort actions), T-028 (docs), T-029 (full gates), T-030..T-032 (human on-device checks).
next_actions: T-025 overlay UI: priority + deadline controls inside the Cmd+N note editor (GroupNoteEditor.swift), saved through the note path - extend the editing session save (endNoteEditing) or add parallel model calls on the same commit point; deadline input as text validated via setGroupDeadline(parsing:) (invalid -> unset per S-039; GroupDeadline.displayText for the current value); priority as a segmented/menu control over GroupPriority? (nil = unset). Keep judgment in the model; the view only forwards.

T-026 display: label band (GroupLabel.swift) subtle priority mark + deadline text, unset hidden; note overview overlay (GroupNoteOverview.swift) shows priority/deadline with the note; single-stage overdue emphasis in both, driven by model.overdueGroupIDs(today:)/isGroupOverdue with today = GroupDeadline(from: Date()) computed at render entry, never in the model state.

T-027 sort actions: new keybind actions sort_groups_by_priority (Cmd+S) / sort_groups_by_deadline (Cmd+Shift+S) following the T-015 end-to-end pattern (Binding.zig, apprt/action.zig appended-last C ABI tags, Surface.zig dispatch, command.zig, Config.zig defaults, xghostty.h, App performability, controller handler); the model-side reorder consumes priorityOrderedVisibleGroupIDs/deadlineOrderedVisibleGroupIDs and rebuilds canonicalGroupTree in that leaf order (visible only, explicit-only, persists until next sort; ordinals follow automatically since they derive from traversal order). Add XGhosttyTests for the layout reorder + hidden-shelf non-effect at the model level.

T-028 docs: SPEC section 23 (deletion protection, cited by shipped code) AND section 24 (priority/deadline/sort: 24.1 data model, 24.2 overdue, 24.3 orderings, 24.4 sort actions + keybinds), section 9.1/10.5 action+keybind tables, test inventory sections, project readme; then T-029 full gates; then one Human-input Recommendation raising T-030/T-031/T-032 together.
